notes:
Lead: NeonForge is building a JetBrains (IntelliJ/PyCharm) plugin that runs a small local symbol index + hybrid LLM completions. Key points from meetings:
- Plugin design: local index (~30-50GB projected), incremental updates on file save, index stored under ~/.neon/index (customer prefers on-prem).
- UX requirement: completions must appear <50ms for local-only suggestions; when invoking deeper LLM completion users accept 150-300ms. They demoed streaming completions with websocket + token-by-token UI.
- Model/version pinning: must pin to exact model artifact for reproducibility (they requested v1.3-quant and a fallback policy to hosted v1.2 when private capacity constrained).
- Security: CTO quote - "We can't send workspace source off-prem for our enterprise customers" -> strong on-prem requirement. Must support SSO (SAML + SCIM), audit logs (12mo), KMS-backed keys, and EU data residency option.
- Performance asks: cold-cache first-token latency concern; want recommendations for KV cache pre-warming and batching thresholds. Interested in Redwood Optimize suggestions for quantization/profile selection.
- Cost sensitivity: willing to pay for predictable ARR but want clear per-token and per-embedding cost breakdowns and cap/burst controls in Console.
- Integrations: want a small CLI for local install, Helm chart for air-gapped installs, and an IntelliJ plugin SDK example for streaming API + editor action bindings.
- Conversations: frequent shorthand in notes. Example: "POC: private, pin v1.3-q, local idx 40GB, perf target 50ms local / 150ms llm".
- Open items: KMS key ceremony checklist (SEC-714), installer signing requirements for corporate mac fleet, model snapshot hashes for pinning, and acceptable fallback privacy policy language.
- Stubs/links: pricing deck + POC runbook in Drive, Fireflies transcription for demo (ff_20260203_neonforge), security ticket SEC-714 tracking KMS questions.
